> 第19章 她还没回来（第1页）
这时，姜哲正好到了茶水间，闻言，愣了下。
他和程源一直觉得容辞不可能真的舍得离开公司。
他们也坚信她一定会找机会留下来。
昨天，接替她工作的徐雪娜到公司上班时，他们还以为容辞会有所行动。
容辞怎么可能会放心让这样的女人留在封庭深身边。
可这两天容辞不但接纳了徐雪娜，还和她相处融洽，现在居然连她这泡咖啡的手艺，也要传授给徐雪娜了？
她认真的完成了她的工作，拒绝了徐雪娜请吃饭的提议，到时间后，打算回家吃个饭后，继续研究关于ai相关内容。
“我想吃小酥肉和马蹄瘦肉汤，妈妈你回来给我做好不好？”
她和封庭深还没正式离婚，封庭深也没打电话来要求她搬出去。
她要回去给女儿做晚饭，她相信封庭深应该不会有意见。
她现在有些累了，且还有自己的安排。
封景心是她的责任没错，但她也有她的生活，她不会再因为她而无条件牺牲自己的时间了。
她说道：“妈妈今天有事，下次吧。”
以前容辞一切安排都优先封庭深和封景心。
今天却连续两次听到了容辞的拒绝。
虽然封景心没有注意到这一点，只以为容辞是真的有事，可习惯了被容辞放在第一位的她，还真很少被容辞这样拒绝。
她觉得委屈：“妈妈你最近怎么总是有这么多事？我不管，我就要吃小酥肉，就要喝马蹄汤！”
封景心“哼”了一声，发脾气地挂了电话。

容辞坐在车子里，红了眼眶，她捂着眼睛，沉默了好一会，才开车离开。
回到家，她随便吃了个面，刚打开电脑，郁默勋就打了个电话过来，“过几天有个宴会，陪我一起出席？我想介绍几个人给你认识。”
郁默勋又问：“你那边什么时候可以交接好？”
封景心挂了电话后，她以为容辞会立刻赶回家哄她，给她做饭。
都一个多小时过去了，都快晚上八点了，容辞还没回来。
管家担心她饿着，劝道：“既然太太有事，小姐你就先吃点垫一下肚子，等太太回来再给你做……”
“我不要！”封景心噘嘴，见容辞居然这么久都没回来，且还一个电话都没有，这回，她是真的委屈了，管家一提，就直接哭了出来：“我就要吃妈妈做的菜——”
管家以为容辞是真的有要事回不来，没法子，想了想，给封庭深打了个电话过去。

Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. Latest chapter_Chapter 19 She hasn’t come back yet Page 1_Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. Yun Zhongmi_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 19 She hasn’t come back yet (Page 1)
At this time, Jiang Zhe happened to arrive at the tea room. Hearing this, he was stunned for a moment.
He and Cheng Yuan had always felt that Rong Ci could not really be willing to leave the company.
They also firmly believe that she will find an opportunity to stay.
Yesterday, when Xu Xuena, who took over her job, came to the company to work, they thought Rong Ci would take action.
How could Rong Ci feel comfortable letting such a woman stay with Feng Tingshen.
But in the past two days, Rong Ci not only accepted Xu Xuena, but also got along well with her. Now she even wants to teach her coffee making skills to Xu Xuena?
She completed her work seriously and declined Xu Xuena's offer to treat her to dinner. When the time was up, she planned to go home and have a meal before continuing to study AI-related content.
"I want to eat short crispy pork and lean water chestnut soup. Mom, can you prepare it for me when you get back?"
She and Feng Tingshen have not officially divorced, and Feng Tingshen has not called to ask her to move out.
She was going back to make dinner for her daughter, and she believed that Feng Tingshen would have no problem with it.
She is a little tired now and has her own arrangements.
It's true that Feng Jingxin is her responsibility, but she also has her own life, and she will no longer unconditionally sacrifice her time because of her.
She said: "Mom has something to do today, let's do it next time."
In the past, Rong Ci gave priority to Feng Tingshen and Feng Jingxin in all arrangements.
Today, I heard Rong Ci's rejection twice in a row.
Although Feng Jingxin didn't notice this and only thought that Rong Ci really had something to do, she was used to being put first by Rong Ci, and it was rare for her to be rejected by Rong Ci like this.
She felt aggrieved: "Mom, why are you always busy with so many things recently? I don't care, I just want to eat crispy pork and drink water chestnut soup!"
Feng Jingxin snorted and hung up the phone angrily.
Rong Ci sat in the car, her eyes red. She covered her eyes and was silent for a long time before driving away.
When she got home, she had some noodles. As soon as she turned on the computer, Yu Moxun called, "There will be a banquet in a few days. Do you want to attend with me? I want to introduce a few people to you."
Yu Moxun asked again: "When can the handover be completed on your side?"
After Feng Jingxin hung up the phone, she thought Rong Ci would rush home immediately to coax her and cook for her.
More than an hour has passed, it's almost eight o'clock in the evening, and Rong Ci still hasn't come back.
The housekeeper was worried that she would be hungry, so he advised her: "Since my wife is busy, Miss, please eat something to fill your stomach first, and then I will cook for you when my wife comes back..."
"I don't want it!" Feng Jingxin pouted, seeing that Rong Ci hadn't come back for so long and hadn't even called her. This time, she was really aggrieved. When the housekeeper mentioned it, she burst into tears: "I want to eat the food cooked by my mother——"
The housekeeper thought that Rong Ci really had something important to do and couldn't come back. He had no choice but to think about it and called Feng Tingshen.
